title: 栈与队列
subtitle: LIFO 与 FIFO 的标准姿势

blocks.text: 用 list 作栈,用 deque 作队列
栈(后进先出)用 list.append()/pop() 即可;队列(先进先出)用 collections.deque 的 append()/popleft(),两端都是 O(1)。

blocks.code:
from collections import deque

stack = []
stack.append(1); stack.append(2)
print(stack.pop(), stack)

queue = deque(['a', 'b'])
queue.append('c')
print(queue.popleft(), list(queue))

blocks.question: 队列的 popleft 若用 list.pop(0) 代替,代价是?
blocks.explain: list 头部删除要移动全部后续元素;deque 两端 O(1)

blocks.text: 栈的经典应用:括号匹配、函数调用栈、DFS

hint: 队列永远别用 list 头部删除

title: 堆与 defaultdict
subtitle: heapq 与带默认值的字典

blocks.text: heapq 是小顶堆:heappush/heappop,O(log n) 取最值,适合 Top-K;defaultdict(k) 访问缺失键时自动建默认值,分组统计代码省去判存。

blocks.code:
import heapq
from collections import defaultdict

nums = [5, 1, 8, 3]
heapq.heapify(nums)
print(heapq.heappop(nums))

groups = defaultdict(list)
for name, dept in [('Alice', 'dev'), ('Bob', 'ops'), ('Carol', 'dev')]:
    groups[dept].append(name)
print(dict(groups))

blocks.question: defaultdict(list) 访问不存在的键会发生?
options: 自动创建空列表并返回
blocks.explain: defaultdict 用工厂函数建默认值,分组统计因此少写 if key in d

blocks.title: 项目:迷你优先级队列
blocks.code:
import heapq

tasks = []
heapq.heappush(tasks, (2, '低优任务'))
heapq.heappush(tasks, (1, '高优任务'))
print(heapq.heappop(tasks))
